comments.html: Nice presentation, you don't happen to have a video of the demo available to, say, upload to Google Videos and share it with the rest of us?

comments.author: ahl
comments.html:
Mikael,
Sorry, it wasn't video taped. The talks were audio recorded, but even that isn't going to help much (except when I was DTracing xmms as it played "Super Freak"). The demos I gave were very roughly a concatenation of what Bryan wrote about demo'ing DTrace and what I wrote about DTrace for Linux.
